Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.item

Interface ItemProvider

public interface ItemProvider
A source of custom items addressed as <namespace>:<id>, next to Zentrix's built-in custom:, itemsadder: and nexo: prefixes.

Once registered through ItemService.registerItemProvider(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.item.ItemProvider), identifiers in the provider's namespace work wherever Zentrix resolves or matches item identifiers through its item manager: ItemService.resolveItem(java.lang.String), ItemService.matchesItem(org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack, java.lang.String), and configuration that refers to items by identifier when it is used, such as class bonus items. The material of entries in content/items.yml is resolved when that file is read - at Zentrix's startup, before dependent addons enable - so such entries resolve from the next /zentrix reload after the provider registered. Loot pools store their items themselves and are not affected.

Calls come from the main thread and must be quick; a provider that throws is treated as not knowing the item.

Since:
1.8.0
